body.message: Hello Maria, Unfortunately, we currently have an in-house guest staying in Unit 3105, so the viewing will not be possible tomorrow. The guest’s check-out date is on 20th July. Kindly let us know if this date would be suitable for you, and we will arrange the viewing accordingly. Please note that the available viewing timings are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM only. Kind regards, Chahana T. fäm Living
